findings.status: RESOLVED 2026-05-22 via TDD — 1-line fix + 5 spec tests
findings.resolution: scope-filter.util.ts:105 changed from 'if (!parent) return' to throw ForbiddenException. Flipped existing test asserting bypass-as-feature. Added 4 new spec tests covering: null parent throws, undefined parent throws, admin (scope=null) bypass preserved, canDispatch bypass preserved. Added 2 documents.service.spec regression tests covering orphan + admin recovery. Full backend jest: 1491 PASS 0 FAIL — ZERO downstream regression (means existing tests never relied on bypass, only the single bypass-contract test). Per ENG-1 classification: 'test bug' category (single spec assert encoded the bypass contract).
findings.title: [RESOLVED] Orphan Document bypass DataScope — crown-jewel hồ sơ bí mật accessible to any authenticated user with Document.read permission
findings.evidence: Document.caseId and Document.incidentId are both nullable (String?). create() at documents.service.ts:151-200 validates each FK only IF provided — never enforces 'at least one parent'. Both onDelete: SetNull, so deleting a Case orphans all its documents. assertParentInScope at scope-filter.util.ts:105 has 'if (!parent) return' — silent pass when parent is null. documents.service.ts:143 calls assertParentInScope(record.case ?? record.incident, dataScope) — if both null, scope check is skipped entirely. Same flaw applies to VksMeetingRecord (schema.prisma:1504-1507) and SuspensionActionPlan (1525-1528) which also have nullable caseId+incidentId.
findings.impact: EXPLOIT: Any authenticated user with Document.read permission (= every investigator/dispatcher/officer) can call GET /api/documents/:id and GET /api/documents/:id/download on orphan documents. Orphan = caseId AND incidentId both null. Crown-jewel data (kết luận điều tra, file attached to cases) leaks across teams and across districts. Ward officer of xã A can download orphan documents originally attached to a Case of district HCM Q1 if they know the document ID. ID enumeration aided by cuid format + leaks in audit logs (DOCUMENT_DELETED events expose subjectId before cascade, plus frontend URLs may have been cached/shared).
findings.exploit_steps: 1. Investigator A creates Document attached to Case X (POST /api/documents). 2. Admin deletes Case X (DELETE /api/cases/:id) → cascade SetNull orphans the Document. 3. Investigator B (different team/district) obtains the document ID (from audit log, shared URL, brute-force enumeration). 4. B requests GET /api/documents/:id → assertParentInScope receives null (record.case=null, record.incident=null), returns silently, document metadata returned. 5. B requests GET /api/documents/:id/download → controller calls getById (silent pass) then getDownloadInfo (no scope check) → file blob streamed to B.
findings.recommended_action: SHIP-BLOCK FIX (minimum): Change scope-filter.util.ts:105 from 'if (!parent) return' to 'if (!parent) { recordDenial("parent-null"); throw new ForbiddenException(FORBIDDEN_MSG); }'. This breaks behavior for any legitimate orphan access (likely zero) but closes the bypass. Defense-in-depth: (a) Add 'at least one of caseId/incidentId required' validation in CreateDocumentDto + similar for VksMeetingRecord/SuspensionActionPlan; (b) Change Document.caseId FK onDelete from SetNull to Cascade so deletion removes documents instead of orphaning; (c) Same audit needed on VksMeetingRecord and SuspensionActionPlan.
findings.effort: M (4-8h: 1h scope-filter fix + spec update, 2h DTO validation across 3 models, 2h schema migration to Cascade, 2h regression testing)
findings.fix_verification: After fix: orphan documents should return 403 on GET /api/documents/:id, even for users with Document.read permission. Existing tests (scope-filter.util.spec.ts:164,320) should be updated to assert ForbiddenException on null parent.

findings.status: RESOLVED 2026-05-22 — full fix: DTO required + BE always-lock + FE expectedUpdatedAt + DB partial unique index + 3 new spec tests

(b) petitions.service.ts:705: always apply updatedAt in tx.petition.update WHERE (no longer conditional). (e) Migration 20260522172600_petition_linked_case_unique: partial unique index `WHERE linkedCaseId IS NOT NULL` + pre-migration safety check (DO $$ raises if duplicates exist). Full backend 1494 PASS, frontend 546 PASS, tsc clean.
findings.title: [RESOLVED] Race condition: concurrent Petition→Case convert tạo orphan Case (frontend không gửi expectedUpdatedAt)
findings.evidence: convertToCase (petitions.service.ts:655) wraps Case creation + Petition update in $transaction. Line 707 has optimistic lock via `where: { id, ...(dto.expectedUpdatedAt ? { updatedAt: ... } : {}) }` — but only if caller sends expectedUpdatedAt. Frontend ConvertToCaseModal at PetitionListPage.tsx:865 calls POST /petitions/:id/convert-case WITHOUT expectedUpdatedAt (sends only caseName, crime, jurisdiction, suspect, prosecutionDecision, prosecutionDate). Plus schema has no unique constraint on linkedCaseId. Result: 2 concurrent calls both pass the `if (petition.linkedCaseId)` check (line 673), both enter transaction, both create Case, last write wins for Petition.linkedCaseId update. First Case becomes orphan (no Petition references it).
findings.impact: Data integrity violation in production: a dispatcher and an investigator clicking 'Convert' simultaneously, OR a user double-clicking, OR network retry of POST, can create N orphan Cases. Orphan Cases appear in /cases list and KPI counts, inflating numbers, untraceable to source Petition. Crown-jewel impact: legal compliance — Case audit chain broken (no petition origin), could violate BLTTHS evidence requirements during prosecution.
findings.exploit_steps: 1. Two dispatchers open same Petition in PetitionListPage. 2. Both click 'Chuyển thành vụ án' near-simultaneously. 3. Both modals POST /api/v1/petitions/:id/convert-case (no expectedUpdatedAt in body). 4. Backend tx A creates Case A, updates Petition.linkedCaseId=A. 5. Backend tx B (running parallel) creates Case B, updates Petition.linkedCaseId=B (overwrites A). 6. Database state: Petition.linkedCaseId=B, Case A exists but no Petition links to it. KPI numbers off by 1.
findings.recommended_action: SHIP-BLOCK FIX: (a) Frontend ConvertToCaseModal at PetitionListPage.tsx:865 must include `expectedUpdatedAt: petition.updatedAt` in POST body. (b) Backend ConvertToCaseDto: make expectedUpdatedAt REQUIRED (currently optional). (c) Backend petitions.service.ts:705-707: remove the conditional wrap, always apply optimistic lock — throw P2025 if updatedAt mismatch. (d) Schema: add partial unique index `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX petition_linked_case_unique ON petitions(linkedCaseId) WHERE linkedCaseId IS NOT NULL` — prevents 2 petitions linking same case AND catches double-convert at DB level.
findings.effort: S (2-4h: frontend 1-line + DTO update + migration + spec)
findings.fix_verification: After fix: write Jest test `Promise.all([...20].map(() => svc.convertToCase(petitionId, dto, actorId)))` — expect exactly 1 success + 19 ConflictException. Frontend manual test: open 2 tabs, click convert simultaneously → second tab gets 'đã được chỉnh sửa bởi người dùng khác' error.

findings.status: RESOLVED 2026-05-22 — added `&& !isWardOfficer` to unassignedMatch check in petitions.service.ts:206
findings.resolution: checkWriteScope now consistent with buildScopeFilter ward officer policy (intake excluded). Closes write-path bypass theoretical risk.
findings.title: [RESOLVED] Ward officer write-scope inconsistent: read-list excludes intake but checkWriteScope allows unassigned petition convert
findings.evidence: scope-filter.util.ts:48 explicitly excludes ward officer from intake (unassigned) records on READ. But petitions.service.ts:206 `unassignedMatch = !record.assignedTeamId && writableTeamIds.length > 0` does NOT check isWardOfficer. Ward officer with any writableTeamIds (their ward team) could theoretically convert an unassigned petition if they obtained the ID through other means. Risk: low because they can't see the ID via list, but policy is inconsistent.
findings.impact: Inconsistent authorization model. If WO obtains petition ID via API leak, frontend bug, or shared URL, they can convert it to Case despite the read-filter design intent. Bypasses the 'WO scoped to their ward only' policy on write path.
findings.recommended_action: Add `&& !dataScope.isWardOfficer` to unassignedMatch line 206. Same logic to be checked across all 12 service files using similar local checkWriteScope methods.

findings.status: RESOLVED 2026-05-22 via TDD — 7 new spec tests + minimal filter update
findings.resolution: Added Logger instance + formatErrorWithCauseChain() helper. Logs non-HttpException OR HttpException ≥500. Walks Error.cause chain up to 10 depth. Handles non-Error throws. Stack stays server-side only (verified by spec). Verified GREEN: 11/11 tests pass, full backend 1486 PASS 0 FAIL.
findings.title: [RESOLVED] GlobalExceptionFilter nuốt stack trace cho non-HttpException — production errors không debug được
findings.evidence: GlobalExceptionFilter.catch chỉ xử lý exception instanceof HttpException (line 22). Non-HttpException errors (raw Error, Prisma error, TypeError, JWT signing fail, fs.readFileSync fail, etc) fall through silently to default 500 response WITHOUT any console.error(exception) call. Stack trace lost entirely. UAT confirm: POST /api/v1/auth/login trả 500 INTERNAL_ERROR với details=[] — không có manh mối debug. Backend stdout dev log 0 bytes vì error swallowed.
findings.impact: BLOCK production debug capability. Khi production lỗi 500 đầu tiên (sẽ xảy ra trong tuần launch), team không debug được — phải reproduce locally (mà có khi không reproduce được vì env khác). Confirmed via UAT: em không debug được login 500 vì filter ẩn stack trace. Crown-jewel risk: nếu attacker tìm cách inject lỗi (DoS via exception flood), defenders không trace nguồn.
findings.exploit_steps: (not exploitation — observability gap) UAT scenario: 1. Send POST /api/v1/auth/login với credentials hợp lệ. 2. Receive {error.code: INTERNAL_ERROR, message: Internal server error, details: []} HTTP 500. 3. Check backend stdout → 0 bytes. 4. Check audit log → no entry (error before log call). 5. No way to diagnose without modifying filter to log.
findings.recommended_action: SHIP-BLOCK FIX (~30min): Update GlobalExceptionFilter.catch to: (a) Inject Logger via constructor + log every non-HttpException with full stack: `this.logger.error('Unhandled exception', exception?.stack ?? String(exception))`; (b) Optionally include error.message in details[] for development env (controlled by NODE_ENV check — don't leak in prod); (c) Log HttpException 500s too (server errors regardless of source). Reference: NestJS docs https://docs.nestjs.com/exception-filters#default-exception-filter pattern.
findings.effort: S (30min — 5 lines + import Logger + verify test)
findings.fix_verification: After fix: trigger login 500, backend stdout shows full stack trace pinpointing line. Em có thể debug nguyên nhân login 500.

findings.title: [RESOLVED] Migration silent drift — DDL không thực thi nhưng record vẫn ghi vào _prisma_migrations
findings.evidence: Phát hiện trong khi debug P0-002: dev DB có _prisma_migrations row cho 20260516120000_magic_link_enrollment nhưng `users` table THIẾU columns `enrollmentTokenHash` + `enrollmentExpiresAt` mà migration SQL khai báo ADD COLUMN. enrollment_token_audits table cũng missing. Không rõ nguyên nhân: có thể ai đó manually DROP COLUMN sau migrate; hoặc PrismaPg adapter bug; hoặc migration đã apply rồi rollback một phần khi schema sync sau đó.
findings.impact: **Production risk:** nếu cùng drift xảy ra trên VM, login sẽ 500 sau deploy. CURRENTLY production OK (deployed 2026-05-12, last verified login worked at audit time?). Nhưng deploy.sh không có post-migration verification step → silent failure có thể xảy ra trong future deploy mà không ai phát hiện cho đến lúc user login.
findings.recommended_action: Add post-migration verification trong deploy.sh: sau `prisma migrate deploy`, run `npx prisma db pull --print` và diff vs schema.prisma → fail deploy nếu drift detected. Alternative: startup health check trong main.ts gọi `prisma.$queryRaw` test query cho mỗi critical table, exit fast với clear error nếu fail.

findings.title: [RESOLVED] Login admin trả HTTP 500 — dev DB schema drift (enrollment columns missing)
findings.evidence: UAT 2026-05-22: POST /api/v1/auth/login {username: admin@pc02.local, password: <SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD>} → HTTP 500 INTERNAL_ERROR. Tried both username=email và username=admin. DB verify: admin user exists, isActive=true, role=ADMIN, totpEnabled=false, twoFaSetupRequired=false, mustChangePassword=false. bcrypt.compare(SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD, passwordHash) returns TRUE in standalone Node script. SystemSetting TWO_FA_ENABLED='false' exists. JWT private.pem exists. Frontend UAT cũng fail — page hiển thị 'Internal server error'. Root cause unknown vì P1-004 (filter nuốt stack trace).
findings.impact: **HỆ THỐNG KHÔNG SỬ DỤNG ĐƯỢC.** Mọi user không login được → toàn bộ feature inaccessible. Launch immediately blocked.
findings.exploit_steps: Reproduce: (1) Start backend `npm run start:dev`, frontend `npm run dev`. (2) Navigate http://localhost:5173 → /login. (3) Fill admin@pc02.local + SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD. (4) Click Đăng nhập. (5) Page shows 'Internal server error', URL stays /login. (6) Backend log 0 bytes (P1-004 root cause).
findings.recommended_action: SHIP-BLOCK: (1) Fix P1-004 first to enable debug. (2) Repro + read backend stdout stack trace. (3) Likely candidates: (a) MetricsService.loginAttempts.inc({result:'success'}) fails (Prometheus client not initialized?); (b) AuditService.log() fails (audit_log INSERT fails — table schema mismatch?); (c) JWT private.pem corrupt/wrong format for RS256; (d) Some env var missing causing settingsService init lazy fail. (4) Once root cause found, write regression test in auth.service.spec.ts.
findings.fix_verification: POST /api/v1/auth/login trả 200 với TokenPair (accessToken + refreshToken). Frontend /login redirect /dashboard. Full UAT flow 1 (login + 2FA + first-login) PASS.

findings.status: RESOLVED 2026-05-22 — FALSE POSITIVE on audit. Verified otplib v13 types-BBT_82HF.d.ts: epochTolerance IS valid option (number of seconds tolerance, not steps). Original code correct.
findings.resolution: Em initially attempted fix changing to `window:1`, TypeScript error revealed `window` NOT in OTPVerifyOptions. Reverted to original `epochTolerance: 30` which is correct (accepts ±30s clock drift = ±1 step in 30s period). Updated code comment to reflect.
findings.title: [FALSE POSITIVE - REVERTED] TOTP epochTolerance:30 là dead code — was actually valid otplib v13 option
findings.evidence: otplib v13.4.0 sử dụng option `window` (number of steps before/after) không phải `epochTolerance` (legacy v9 option). Code pass `epochTolerance: 30` — option bị ignore, fallback `window: 0` = chỉ accept current 30s window. Lucky: behavior thực tế là SAFE (strict ±30s). Nhưng comment intent có thể là 'allow 30s tolerance' = developer nghĩ đang nới window. Risk: nếu sau này refactor / upgrade otplib, behavior đổi bất ngờ.
findings.impact: No exploit risk hiện tại (window=0 strict). Code smell — false sense of configuration. Maintenance trap.
findings.recommended_action: Đổi `epochTolerance: 30` thành `window: 1` (= accept ±1 step, ±30s clock drift) — đây có vẻ là intent ban đầu. Hoặc xoá hoàn toàn nếu strict mode mong muốn. Add comment giải thích choice.

findings.status: RESOLVED 2026-05-22 — Day 6 promoted from deferred to fixed
findings.resolution: service.disableTotp(userId, currentTotpCode?) — if totpEnabled=true, requires currentTotpCode and verifies via verifyTotp(). Idempotent disable (already-off users) still works. Controller accepts body { currentTotpCode }. 2 new spec tests. Backend 1496 PASS.
findings.title: [RESOLVED] /auth/2fa/disable không yêu cầu confirm TOTP code hiện tại trước khi tắt
findings.evidence: DELETE /auth/2fa/disable chỉ require JwtAuthGuard + UserThrottlerGuard (3/min). Không có DTO body với current TOTP code. User có session token hợp lệ có thể tắt 2FA mà KHÔNG cần chứng minh giữ second factor. Mitigation: nếu SETTINGS_KEY.TWO_FA_ENABLED='true' (system enforce), disableTotp throws BadRequestException ngay đầu (line 369-371) → endpoint coi như no-op.
findings.impact: Risk hiện tại thấp: (a) nếu system enforce 2FA → endpoint blocked; (b) nếu không enforce, session token theft (XSS/log leak) đã là tự thân vấn đề lớn hơn. Nhưng best-practice: disable second factor phải require second factor confirm — prevent silent removal nếu attacker chỉ có session ngắn hạn không có TOTP device.
findings.recommended_action: Thêm `currentTotpCode` field vào disable endpoint DTO + verify trước khi disable. Có thể skip nếu system enforce mode (line 369 đã chặn). Pattern tham khảo: GitHub, Google account settings — require password OR 2FA reverify để disable 2FA.

findings.status: DEFERRED 2026-05-22 — exploitability analysis: LOW. Override attempt failed (npm lockfile pinning)
findings.resolution: CVE GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq affects uuid v3/v5/v6 when buf parameter provided. exceljs 4.4.0 (latest) uses uuid 8.3.2 internally for v4 random IDs only (random does NOT accept buf param). Tried npm overrides `uuid: ^11.1.1` — lockfile didn't resolve, would need full lock regeneration which risks other dep cascade. Accept-risk for launch. Tier-2 post-launch: wait for exceljs to bump uuid, or vendor patch.
findings.title: [ACCEPTED-RISK] exceljs (>=3.5.0) phụ thuộc uuid <11.1.1 — CVE GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq, exploitability LOW (uuid v4 only used)
findings.evidence: npm audit reports exceljs moderate severity via uuid CVE GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq (CVSS 7.5 — missing buffer bounds check in uuid v3/v5/v6 when buf parameter provided). exceljs uses uuid internally for ID generation. Bulk import endpoint accepts user-uploaded .xlsx files → if attacker crafts file triggering uuid call with attacker-controlled buf, potential buffer overflow.
findings.impact: Moderate. Bulk import is admin-only endpoint (gated by RBAC) — attacker needs admin compromise first. But Excel reports (reports/exports) generate Excel server-side from DB data, not user input — lower risk. Exploit complexity high (need internal exceljs path to expose uuid buf param). Frontend audit clean.
findings.recommended_action: Upgrade exceljs to latest (may be major bump, will need migration testing). Alternative: pin uuid >=11.1.1 in overrides. Run `npm audit fix --force` cautiously (downgrade exceljs to 3.4.0 is suggested but old). Defer to Tier-2 (post-launch dependency sprint).
